blocks.passage: Mr. Saberian is a translator who works for IRIB. He knows four languages: Persian, English, French, and Russian. He learned English at school when he was 13 years old. He began learning French in a language institute when he was 15. Then, he learned Russian when he was a university student in Moscow. Interestingly, he speaks all of these languages fluently, but he uses English more. To learn a foreign language, he says that interest and hard work are really more important than age.

blocks.passage:
Technology has had both positive and negative effects on people's lives. It has enabled us to have easy access to information, become more creative, travel easier, and have a more comfortable life. Technology has also helped the researchers and scientists of our time. New technologies have helped doctors to understand how diseases develop. Technology, as some people may think, is not a bad thing at all. The way we use technology, is important. For example, using new technologies has changed people's lifestyle in a harmful way in this century.
Some technologies are dangerous to our health and can harm our body. Using mobile phones or surfing the Internet for long hours can increase people's blood pressure, cause sleep problems, and depression. Playing video games for long hours makes people nervous and harm their heart and nervous system. Listening to music by headsets can be harmful to one's hearing and even brain. So, we should be careful in choosing the right technology. We should also limit the time of working with technologies.

blocks.passage: Art is something that people create with imagination and skill. Art has different forms including paintings, drawings, photos, or even things made by hand. Artists make art for some reasons such as enjoying it, or selling their artworks to make money. They can sell it to those who collect art in places like art stores, galleries, or online. But, it's not always easy to make money from art. Artists have to find people who are interested in their works. Nowadays, artists let others know about their art by showing it in galleries or using the Internet, which takes a lot of work. Also, the value of art can be different to various people. Some might like a piece of art and have it for themselves, but others might not. Artists can find their own style and make special things to get people's attention. To make money, artists can do many things such as teaching in art classes, or selling artistic items. They can also work with companies to make particular art projects. In conclusion, art can be an acceptable way to earn money, but it cannot be easy. Artists have to connect with the buyers, and let people know about their art. In this way, they can create good feelings in the society and bring people together.
